abstract: Primary malignant mediastinal germ cell tumors (GCTs) are rare pediatric tumors that have a poorer prognosis than GCTs occurring elsewhere in the body. Due to their rarity and aggressiveness, they are often locally advanced and unresectable at diagnosis, and currently, there is no standard optimal treatment approach. Herein, we present a rare case of pediatric anterior mediastinal yolk sac tumor (YST) diagnosed as pathological complete response (CR) to chemotherapy but prematurely required pulmonary metastasectomy of mixed GCT consisting of seminoma and YST. Testicular GCTs can relapse as tumors of subtypes that are pathologically different from the primary tumor, each having distinct pathogenesis, treatment modality, and prognosis; however, this phenomenon is seldom reported in mediastinal GCTs. This report reviewed the discordance of histological composition between primary and metastatic tumors. When treating mediastinal nonseminomatous GCTs, the possibility of early recurrence should be considered, even if the primary tumor is completely resected and diagnosed as pathological CR to chemotherapy.
abstract_ja: 小児の前縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍に対して化学療法を行い、病理学的完全奏効（CR）と判定されたが、早期に混合型胚細胞腫瘍（セミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍）の肺転移に対する転移巣切除を要した症例を報告する。原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍は予後不良で、標準治療が確立していない。精巣原発の胚細胞腫瘍は原発巣と病理組織型の異なる亜型として再発することがあるが、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍では稀である。本報告では、原発巣と転移巣の組織学的不一致について検討した。非セミノーマ性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の治療では、原発巣が完全切除され病理学的CRと判定された場合でも、早期再発の可能性を考慮すべきである。
